title: Require Domain Source Topology
forbids: domain roots outside the positive contract, router, model, and semantic module spine
why: A domain root is one public aggregate over semantic modules. Keeping modules under modules/ and shared vocabulary under model/ prevents routers, atoms, and policy from appearing as equivalent direct children while leaving each child kind to its own blueprint.
remediate: Keep index.ts, contract.ts, router.ts, and modules; add model only for vocabulary genuinely shared by multiple modules, and move every other child to its owning kind.
message: Domain roots should match the positive model-and-modules aggregate spine.
